desc: Ideate the band-optimized Levenshtein distance approach.
Implement the Levenshtein distance algorithm with the band optimization (width K).
Read inputs K, S, and T from standard input.
Compute the minimum edit distance using the band-limited DP.
If the computed distance is less than or equal to K, print "Yes"; otherwise, print "No".
Ensure the solution handles large strings efficiently without allocating a full N x M matrix.
Verify the solution against the provided sample inputs (Sample 1: Yes, Sample 2: No, Sample 3: Yes).
Check for potential off-by-one errors or boundary condition issues in the band logic.
